title: It Loved Them To Death
author: Brennan Hatton
variants:
This one is hard to write.


%TARGET% didnt walk away.


Your echo is why.


Before you decide what that means:


it didnt start it.


It doesnt start things. Thats not what you sent.


%STORY%


It happened at carriage %CARRIAGE%.
%DAYS% days of standing still.
%GEAR%


It defended itself.
It was very good at that.
You made sure of it.


Thats the part I keep turning over.


You sent something that loved them, and you sent it armed.


It would have given them everything.


They swung first.


It was still yours.

It ended badly.


Not the way the other kind ends badly.


Worse, maybe.


%TARGET% attacked it.
It killed them.


Both of those are true and neither is the whole thing.


%STORY%


%DAYS% days it waited at carriage %CARRIAGE% to be gentle with someone.
%GEAR%


A thing can love you and still have hands.


Nobody won.


The train doesnt keep a page for that, so it keeps this one.


If it helps:


it wasnt angry.


Not even at the end.
